### SES AI Announces Date of Conference Call for Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 22, 2026


WOBURN, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[SES AI Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ses.ai%2F&esheet=54626603&newsitemid=20261022918770&lan=en-US&anchor=SES+AI+Corporation&index=1&md5=df1d46d964b4b371ed708cf56f62f824) (“SES AI,” the “Company,” “we” or “us”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance NDAA-compliant Li-ion and Anode-Free Li-Metal batteries, today announced it will release its 2026 third quarter financial results before market opens on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET.


A webcast of the live conference call will be available through SES’s Investor Relations website,[https://investors.ses.ai](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.ses.ai&esheet=54626603&newsitemid=20261022918770&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.ses.ai&index=2&md5=dc79113d9022a8246a36049fa58b4f3a) . The following link can be used to register in advance for the call:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/310176029](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F310176029&esheet=54626603&newsitemid=20261022918770&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F310176029&index=3&md5=ea45ed25e1b7fd53da1cf5813ebdbb7b) **.**

**About SES AI:** SES AI Corp. (NYSE: SES) is powering the future of global electric transportation on land and in the air with the world’s most advanced Li-ion and Anode-Free Li-Metal batteries. SES AI is the first battery company in the world to accelerate its pace of innovation by utilizing superintelligent AI across the spectrum of its business, from research and development; materials sourcing; cell design; engineering and manufacturing; to battery health and safety monitoring. Founded in 2012, SES AI is an advanced Li-ion and Anode-Free Li-Metal battery developer and manufacturer headquartered in Boston and with NDAA-compliant manufacturing plant in Chungju, South Korea. Learn more at[SES.AI](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ses.ai%2F&esheet=54626603&newsitemid=20261022918770&lan=en-US&anchor=SES.AI&index=6&md5=562d015b1301ff01834af88dc0d51767) .
